## About Dcodes Technologies

Dcodes Technologies is an IT and device repair company that also delivers custom software and digital marketing. We work with small and mid-size businesses that need a website, an app, internal business software (ERP, CRM) or paid-ads growth, with one team handling design, development, delivery and support.

Page: https://www.dcodestech.com/AboutUs

Core strengths:
- Full-stack web application development (Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase, Tailwind CSS, PHP)
- Custom ERP, CRM and management systems built around a client's workflow
- Mobile and app development
- Performance marketing: Meta Ads and Google Ads, plus SEO
- IT and device repair support

---

## Services

### 1. Web Development
URL: https://www.dcodestech.com/services/webDevelopment

Custom business websites, landing pages, e-commerce and full-stack web applications. Typical stack: Next.js (TypeScript), Firebase, Tailwind CSS, and PHP-based builds. Work includes responsive UI, admin panels, blog/CMS systems, SEO-friendly structure and deployment.

Best for: businesses that need a new website, a redesign, or a custom web portal/dashboard.

### 2. App Development
URL: https://www.dcodestech.com/services/appDevelopment

Mobile and app development for business use cases, from customer-facing apps to internal tools.

Best for: businesses that want an app for customers, staff or operations.

### 3. Digital Marketing
URL: https://www.dcodestech.com/services/digitalMarketing

Online growth services including SEO, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns.

Best for: businesses that want more leads, calls or sales from online channels.

### 4. ERP System
URL: https://www.dcodestech.com/services/erpSystem

Custom ERP development: inventory, orders, billing, HR, reporting and role-based access, tailored to how the client's business actually runs.

Best for: companies replacing spreadsheets or disconnected tools with one system.
